g.text: A unit sphere, a zero-mean plane, and their great circle
The white circle is S² ∩ H. Every centered unit feature vector ends on it; off-plane sphere points are not centered.
The angle is between radius vectors from the origin.
Perspective on the left does not preserve angles.
